## `src/error.rs`

### enum `Error`

Errors this crate returns.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("invalid name: {0}")]
    InvalidName(String),
    #[error("cannot parse knowledge base id: {0}")]
    BadBaseId(String),
    #[error("no such knowledge base: {0}")]
    NoSuchBase(String),
    #[error("knowledge base already exists: {0}")]
    BaseExists(String),
    #[error("no such knowledge: {0}")]
    NoSuchKnowledge(String),
    #[error("unknown knowledge backend provider: {0}")]
    NoSuchProvider(String),
    #[error("{reader} may not {verb} {base}")]
    Denied {
        reader: String,
        verb: &'static str,
        base: String,
    },
    #[error("knowledge needs a title or a body")]
    Empty,
    #[error("embedding failed: {0}")]
    Embed(String),
    #[error("knowledge backend: {0}")]
    Backend(String),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Config(adi_config::Error),
    #[error(transparent)]
    Io(std::io::Error),
}
```

### type `Result`

The result type every fallible call in this crate returns.

```rust
pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;
```

### struct `KnowledgePatch`

An edit. Every field is "leave it alone" when absent — the same omit-to-keep rule the rest of the platform's `save` paths follow, so a caller that only knows about titles cannot blank a body it never asked about.

```rust
    pub tags: Option<Vec<String>>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub source: Option<Option<String>>,
}
```
